> How It Works

01. Connect

Connect your wallet to Sepolia testnet. The site auto-switches to the right network.

02. Pick a Block

Pick a block that the hamster has already mined. Max supply is 10,000 blocks — check the current chain height to see what's available right now.

03. Mint & View

Mint your block data card. View it anytime in the gallery — each card shows round, work, and rarity.

> Why Collect?

Early Blocks = Legendary

Blocks #1-#10 are Legendary. #11-#100 are Epic. The earlier you mint, the rarer the card — these are the genesis blocks of SqueekChain history.

Fully On-Chain

No IPFS. No external hosting. The entire SVG art is generated and stored on Ethereum. Your NFT lives as long as Sepolia exists.

Milestone Blocks

Every 1,000th block is a Milestone. Every 100th is Notable. These special blocks mark key moments in the hamster's journey.

Free to Mint

Only pay Sepolia gas. No mint fee. Connect your wallet, pick a block, mint. Grab some Sepolia ETH from a faucet and start collecting.
